blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Counsel for the House prosecution panel Atty. Lorna Kapunan has questioned how Cale88 Foods Corp. organized its banana-chip export operations, pointing to workforce entries and production-inventory records examined during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Kapunan contrasted the company’s reported business activity with the limited staffing reflected in its corporate filings and asked who performed the work behind the exports. “Banana chips daw ang negosyo pero walang saging sa libro,” she said. “Pwede ka bang mag-banana chips na walang banana?” Kapunan asked.
